description: What SHOW COLUMNS' fixed cell means for a BINARY: it reads the SPELLING, not the family and not declared-vs-derived - a column or CAST spelled BINARY is fixed (width or not, whatever the operand), VARBINARY is not though it reports the same type name, concatenations, every binary-returning function (conversions, decoders, hashes, crypto, AS_BINARY/STRING_AS_BINARY) and X-literals are not, a UNION of equally wide branches stays fixed even BINARY-beside-VARBINARY (so the flag is not ANDed across branches), and the string family reads false throughout. All live-measured. Converted 1:1 from expressions/BinaryFixedFlagTest (now retired).
